generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bidder should have achieved in at least two financial years an Average financial turn-over of not less than amount put to tender in last five years

The Intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one any similar work such as Dam and allied work of value not less than 50percentage of the amount put to tender during last five years reckoned back from 2026-27 work executed during, 2021 22 2022 23 2023 24,2024 25 and 2025 26 will be considered. The work done certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division equivalent officer next higher officer.
The requisite EMD in electronic cash
Latest copy of the Income Tax return filed mentioning the PAN and TAN Nos
Copy of the CEIG class 1 Electrical contractor license mechanical 4 and above registration certificate
At the time of agreement the successful bidder should deposit FSD amount in the form of FDR in favour of Executive Engineer KNNL IPC Division No.01 Kalaburagi. DDs and BG not accepted.
Scanned Signature of the Contractor while uploading the tenders through e-portal

Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the employer a security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 3percentage upto 31.03.2023 and 5percentage beyond 31.03.2023 As per GoK order No. FD456 EXP12 2022 Bengaluru dtd 10.08.2022 of the contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract, through Bankers Cheque Demand Draft Pay in favour of Executive Engineer, KNNL, IPC, Division No.1 Kalaburagi.

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying cretria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity A N 2.5-B

If the percentage quoted by Contractor for work is below 90percentage of the estimated amount put to tender or recast amount put to tender, then successful bidder shall furnish an Additional Performance Security in the form of FDR for an amount equal to the difference between the cost as per quoted percentage and 90 percentage of the estimated amount put to tender or recast amount put to tender. In case of contractor quotation rates above the 125 percentage of the estimated rates then the amount over and above 125 percentage will be withheld during the progress of work.
All conditions are as per bid document

itemList.description: Dis-assembly of existing hoist assembly, removal of old shafts, gates, using chain pulley, rollers etc., complete

Providing Bulk head to close the mouth of Tunnel at 40 ft in the reservoir by diving team in under water condition and dewatering the tunnel by 10 HP Pumps etc.(Item approved by KNNL IPC Circle Kalaburugi)

Design, fabrication, supply, erection and commissioning of embedded parts consisting of sill beam, wheel tracks, seal seats, guide rails, breast wall liner upto 1m height above the roof of vent with all accessories for river / canal sluice emergency gate including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cutting, aligning, welding anchoring, finishing, cleaning, applying one coat of zinc rich epoxy primer and four coats of cold applied coal tar epoxy paint and all other ancillary operations complete as per specifications and approved drawings.
without groove liners
Note:
1. Wt of 1 set embedded parts in tonnes = 0.0444 x ( L2 x H x h )0.659
Weight of breast wall lining : 250 kg per m2 of breast wall
Where ( L ) is length = Clear vent opening in m + 0.70 m.
( H ) is height of gate in m = Clear vent height in m + 0.30 m
( h ) is head of water above sill of gate in m = FRL - Sill level
2. Quantity of structural steel = 87.0 % of computed weight of 1 set.(WRD CSR 2023-24 Vol-IV, P.No. 77, I.No. 6.14.1)

Design, fabrication, supply, erection, testing and commissioning of fixed wheel type vertical lift emergency gate consisting of skin plate, horizontal and vertical girders, wheels, stiffeners, lifting brackets, guide rollers, ballast blocks, teflon claded rubber seals with all accessories for river sluice / canal sluice vent including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cutting, aligning, welding, finishing, cleaning, applying one coat of zinc rich epoxy primer and three coats of cold applied coal tar epoxy paint, seal fixing and all other ancillary operations complete as per specifications and approved drawings.
Note:
1. Wt of 1 gate in tonnes ( including ballast ) = 0.0888 ( L2 x H x h)0.659
Where ( L ) is length = Clear vent opening in m + 0.70 m.
( H ) is height of gate in m = Clear vent height in m + 0.30 m
( h ) is head of water above sill of gate in m = FRL - Sill level
2. Quantity of structural steel = 46.7 % of computed weight of 1 gate.(WRD CSR 2023-24 Vol-IV, P.No. 78, I.No. 6.15)

without groove liner

Providing Driving Team and Driving Equipment 4 Divers, 1 Supervisor, 2 Labour, 1 Vehicle at site for Four Days and Providing 2 numbers, Kmb, 2 Umbicle, 2 LP Compressor and engine driveng LP Compressor, Divers Equipment ,etc and floting platform, (Item approved by KNNL IPC Circle Kalaburugi)

Providing and fixing 25 mm dia. steel rock bolts with one end provided with mechanical / wedge type anchorage and other end provided with threads for fixing washers and nuts including cost of all materials, machinery,labour, ventilation, lighting, drainage, drilling 32 mm dia holes, providing 150 mm long 20 mm thick steel tapered wedge, providing 10 mm thick and 200 x 200 mm size plate washer and nuts, driving bolt, fixing washers and nuts, tightening bolt by torque wrench and all other ancillary operations complete. (WRD CSR 2023-24 Vol-IV, P.No. 66, I.No. 5.9)

Supplying and drawing Flexible Multicore 3C x 6 mm2 Cable manufactured with electrolytic grade flexible copper with low conductor confirming to IS8130-1984 and (Virgin) PVC insulation sheathed suitable for working voltage upto 1100 Volts as per IS-694:1990. (Electrical CSR 2023-24 Vol-VI, P.No. 6 of 105, I.No. 2.5.22)

Loosening, leveling and Compacting original ground supporting embankment to facilitate placement of first layer of embankment, scarified to a depth of 150 mm, mixed with water at OMC and then compacted by rolling so as to achieve minimum dry density as given in Table 300-2 for embankment construction (CSR 2023-24 Vol-3 I.No. 3.7)

Construction of Embankment by excavating the available approved Gravel/ Murrum deposited at a place or borrow pits during or prior excavation with all lifts and lead, transportation to site, spreading, grading to required slope and compacting to meet the requirement complete as per specifications, including cost of labour,rolling,water,all materials,usage& all other appurtenaces required to complete the work.(CSR 2023-24 Vol-1 I.No. 1.8)
